reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Subscribed thinking I would get the 3 day free trial never received it and got charged automatically for the yearly subscription. Tried to send a text on the app and seen they want me to spend more on coins just to send a text which is double dipping. Been trying to get a refund for days no to no avail. Very dissatisfied hope to get my refund through their company.
